evidence: The quality and InN percent of the films were characterized by u–2u x-ray diffraction (u–2u XRD) and x-ray rocking curve (XRC). Figure 1 plots the InN percent, as determined by u–2u XRD, in InGaN as a function of the hydrogen flow injected with the nitrogen carrier gas. All of the samples were grown by MOCVD using 1 sccm of TMGa (210 °C), and 90 sccm of EDMIn (110 °C) in 5 slm of nitrogen carrier gas and 5 slm of ammonia at the temperatures and hydrogen flows indicated.
